messages:
Mika Chen: kicking off an observability bridge probe for ap-southeast GPU pool. goal: logs + metrics + traces smoke, baseline dashboards, and alert templates. who can take what? :eyes:

Ryan Patel: I can run log ingestion and forwarding checks. will start with fluentd/forwarder config + check S3/bucket permissions. link to runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/obs-provisioning

Anu Singh: I'll validate Grafana dashboards and the alert rule set. heads-up: the node-exporter can't run as a daemonset on our custom GPU AMI without the seccomp profile tweak. may need a sidecar or hostProc mount.

Samir Roy: networking gotcha: the GPU subnets are private with no NAT by default. metrics/exporters need egress to ingest endpoints. options: NAT gateway (costly) or VPC endpoint to our logging endpoint. estimate NAT egress ~8TB/month -> ~$700/mo on this cluster.

Leah Torres: can infra-automation-bot probe for available endpoints in the region and confirm if VPC endpoints for logging exist in ap-southeast? if not, we should prefer VPC endpoint creation over NAT.

infra-automation-bot: running region probe: ap-southeast availability:
```
> region: ap-southeast-2
> logging.vpce: not-present
> metrics.vpce: present
> trace.vpce: present
> nat-gateways: 0
> recommended-path: create logging VPC endpoint or enable NAT
> cost-estimate-nat-egress: 8.2 TB/mo (~$720)
```

Mika Chen: thanks. so logging vpce missing. Ryan, follow up to create VPC endpoint? If ops wants to avoid infra change, we can enable temporary NAT but prefer endpoint.

Ryan Patel: will open infra ticket for logging VPC endpoint and include route table updates. ETA: 3 business days. I will meanwhile run fluentd smoke locally and push to staging bucket.

Anu Singh: dashboard checklist I'm running through: GPU utilization panels, per-node nvml metrics, pod-level latency, prefix cache hit-rate, logs per-second ingestion, and long-tail token gen latency. small alert rules to add now:
```
- alert: GPU_OOM_Rate
  expr: increase(gpu_oom_total[5m]) > 0
  for: 2m
  labels: {severity: page}
  annotations: {summary: "GPU OOMs on {{ $labels.instance }}"}

- alert: High_Log_Error_Rate
  expr: increase(app_log_errors_total[5m]) / increase(app_log_lines_total[5m]) > 0.05
  for: 5m
  labels: {severity: ticket}
```

Samir Roy: also add network alert: dropped_packets_on_gpu_net > 1000 in 5m => warn, and dataplane egress spike rule to catch NAT cost anomaly.

Leah Torres: deploy-bot, can you apply the alert templates to staging and run the smoke deploy? tag with channel #oncall for pages.

deploy-bot: applying alert templates to staging namespace 'obs-staging'...
- created ConfigMap: obs-alerts-2026-211111
- applied PrometheusRule: obs-gpu-rules
- result: success

deploy-bot: running smoke queries:
```
- query: increase(gpu_oom_total[5m]) -> 0
- query: rate(flush_errors_total[5m]) -> 0
- query: scrape_success{job="node-exporter"} -> 1
```
all checks passed :thumbsup:

Mika Chen: nice. next steps: (1) infra ticket for logging VPC endpoint (Ryan), (2) Anu to publish dashboard link and pin to team dashboard folder, (3) Samir to add network/dubious-cost alerts, (4) Leah to schedule a brief handoff call with oncall after endpoint is live.

Ryan Patel: opened INFRA-4521 with details, assigned to infra team A. included cost/rollback plan.

Anu Singh: dashboards published: https://grafana.redwood/d/obs/ap-southeast-gpu-summary. shared with team, added readonly link to runbook.

Samir Roy: added network + egress cost anomaly alert to staging rules. will tune thresholds after 48h of telemetry.

Leah Torres: scheduling 30m handoff: tomorrow 10:00 UTC, invite sent to #oncall and infra. :calendar:

Mika Chen: thanks all. follow-ups tracked in the runbook and INFRA-4521. we'll re-run the probe after VPC endpoint is in place. :white_check_mark:
